name: Stateful Web Productivity & Kanban Tool
description: Interactive workflow applications, task boards, markdown previewers, and local state persistence

architecture.html_scaffold:

architecture.css_design_system: body { background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 20px; } .board-container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; max-width: 1200px; margin: 20px auto; } .column { background: #1e293b; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #334155; min-height: 400px; } .task-card { background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #475569; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; } .task-card:hover { border-color: #38bdf8; transform: translateY(-2px); }
architecture.js_state_machine:
let tasks = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('flow_tasks') || '[]'); function saveAndRender() { localStorage.setItem('flow_tasks', JSON.stringify(tasks)); renderBoard(); } function renderBoard() { ['todo', 'progress', 'done'].forEach(status => { const list = document.querySelector(`.card-list[data-status='${status}']`); const filtered = tasks.filter(t => t.status === status); list.innerHTML = filtered.map(t => `
${t.title}
`).join(''); }); }
